title: Et vidit Deus. Et erant valde bona.
html_source:
Genesis 1:4 God saw that the light was good,

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: There is no word for “light” in the latin text. It is based rather on Genesis 1:31: God saw all that he had made, and it was very good.
